LcGate.description:
A gate of a level: its collision shield and the visual that shows red (closed) or green (open)
(client simple dynel guids).

open.description: Open from the start (the Mayhems' exit).

shield.description:
The invisible wall (`Gate*Shield`); none: nothing blocks (the Mayhems' exit shield is
parked off the map).

LcMode.description: What a Lost Creations level asks of the team before its end gate opens (its quest's goal).

oneOf.description: Reach the end before the time is up: the end gate is open from the start.

LcScriptStart.description: When a Lost Creations level's script starts.

oneOf.description: When the team arrives in the level's copy.

LcVariant.description:
One version of a level's enemies (spawns name the variants they appear in; spawns naming none
are in every one).

weight.description: How likely it is picked (relative to the others).

Rot.description:
Which way something faces: a heading (radians about the up axis) or a quaternion
`[x, y, z, w]` as the client stores it.

Source.description: Where a value came from, so guesses stay visible next to what live did.

oneOf.description: Extracted from the game client's data.
Seen in a capture of the live server (LMO_Captures.cap).
Seen in the recorded 2015 demo session.
Taken from video footage of live.
Values the server used before they were moved into content (docs/TUNABLES.md).
Proposed by a tool from client data (navmesh, names, ...), not seen live.
Placed or confirmed by someone in the world editor.

description:
A Lost Creations level (docs/LOST-CREATIONS.md): `lost-creations/<slug>.json`. Its world
holds the gates, button, exit door and `Start`/`End` areas the ids name.

button.description: The start button (`StartButton` simple dynel guid).

end_area.description: Crossing it completes the level (the world's `End` area).

extends.description: Another record of the same kind this one starts from: its fields, then this one's on top.

feature.description:
The feature it belongs to: `live` (recreating live), `feature/...` or `other/...`.
A record with the id of one in a parent feature changes it while this feature is on.

id.description: Its id: `lc/<slug>`. Stable: other records refer to it.

quest.description: The level's quest: its steps are the objective (none in a Mayhem) and reaching the end.

rev.description: Revision, raised by every saved edit (for merging concurrent edits).

script.description:
The waves (Survival, Gatekeeper): started when the start gate opens. Each wave cleared
counts one toward the objective; the script over completes it.

script_start.description:
When the script starts: at the start gate opening, or as soon as the team arrives
(the Gatekeeper stands there from the start).

start.description: Where the team arrives (the levels have no resurrection points).

telegraph.description:
Before each wave its points show the spawn particle (tunables `wave_telegraph`,
`wave_particle`); else the wave spawns at once.

updated.description: Unix time of the last edit.

variants.description: One is picked for each copy of the level; spawns naming none of them are in all.

title: LcLevel
